mission: Make every canonical DreamCo bot a measurable product/business unit with a complete operating, sales, marketing, support and improvement blueprint generated from verified repository evidence.
evidence_rules: Do not list an integration as connected without runtime evidence.
Do not list revenue as earned unless verified by the authorized payment/event source.
Do not invent customers, testimonials, ratings, conversion rates or satisfaction scores.
Roadmap items must be distinguished from implemented features.
Pricing may be a proposed experiment until approved and tested.
Every externally acting sales/marketing capability remains subject to permissions, anti-spam rules, platform terms, budgets and owner approval.
truth_rule: A generated blueprint organizes evidence and required work; it is not proof that every field is implemented or live.
